frames.narration: Two neighbouring folders hold everything related to adapters and price-oracles: src slash adapters and src slash interfaces. What follows maps out every contract that lives there so you always know where to look.
frames.text_content:
## Key Folders

- `src/adapters`: Adapter implementations
- `src/interfaces`: Interface definitions

frames.narration: Inside src adapters you will encounter four Solidity files—Abstract-Fee-Vault, ETH USD Converter, ETH USD Price-Feed-Adapter, and Euler-USDC-Adapter —each providing a concrete part of the system.
frames.text_content:
## Adapter Files in `src/adapters`

- `AbstractFeeVault.sol`
- `ETHUSDConverter.sol`
- `ETHUSDPriceFeedAdapter.sol`
- `EulerUSDCAdapter.sol`

Each file provides a concrete implementation of the adapter system.

frames.narration: The adapters depend on only two tiny interfaces from src slash interfaces, namely `I-Token-Adapter` and `I-Yield-Token`; the others in that folder serve unrelated parts of the codebase.
frames.text_content:
## Interface Files in `src/interfaces`

- `ITokenAdapter.sol`
- `IYieldToken.sol`

These two files define the core interfaces that adapters must implement.

frames.narration: I-Token-Adapter is the interface every concrete adapter must satisfy—it exposes view functions for version, token, underlying-token, and price.
frames.content_with_line_numbers:
1: pragma solidity >=0.5.0;
   2: 
   3: /// @title  ITokenAdapter
   4: /// @author Alchemix Finance
   5: interface ITokenAdapter {
   6:     /// @notice Gets the current version.
   7:     ///
   8:     /// @return The version.
   9:     function version() external view returns (string memory);
  10: 
  11:     /// @notice Gets the address of the yield token that this adapter supports.
  12:     ///
  13:     /// @return The address of the yield token.
  14:     function token() external view returns (address);
  15: 
  16:     /// @notice Gets the address of the underlying token that the yield token wraps.
  17:     ///
  18:     /// @return The address of the underlying token.
  19:     function underlyingToken() external view returns (address);
  20: 
  21:     /// @notice Gets the number of underlying tokens that a single whole yield token is redeemable
  22:     ///         for.
  23:     ///
  24:     /// @return The price.
  25:     function price() external view returns (uint256);
  26: }

frames.narration: IYieldToken is even slimmer, exposing only the price view that higher-level helpers use.

AbstractFeeVault provides shared bookkeeping: an immutable token address (line 13), an authorised-withdrawers mapping (line 22), three emitted events (lines 25-27), and the onlyAuthorized guard (lines 32-35).
At the very bottom of Abstract-Fee-Vault we see two abstract functions each concrete implementation have to implement: withdraw- and total-deposits.
ETH-USD-Converter is a pure Solidity library; its header declares two Chainlink-health custom errors and the public ETH-To-USD helper.
The symmetric USD-TO-ETH routine lives a few lines lower and mirrors the same safety checks.
A final helper—converting arbitrary-decimal tokens to six-decimal USDC—keeps price math consistent across assets.

ETHUSDPriceFeedAdapter wires the converter to a live Chainlink Aggregator: its constructor stores feed metadata (lines 37-41) and its three public view functions pass calls straight through to the library.

Euler-USDC-Adapter is a concrete implementation of I-Token-Adapter—it advertises version one point zero point zero—stores immutable token and underlying-token addresses—and resolves price via the ERC-4626 Convert-To-Assets helper.
